chapter_note: Heavily damaged chapter (81.5%) using a grain/elements parable applied to the Manichaean Church. The title preserves a substantive cosmological topic (grain formed and destroyed by elements). The cosmological core (i=6-8, 22-26) describes how heat/cold work on grain via the five elements, how Hyle's energeia inundates with shadow and destroys the fruits of all trees. The middle of the chapter pivots to ecclesial application (Church, teachers, righteousness gathered through the elect). Final segments return to cosmological description of Hyle and shadow.
